title: Exact minimum-cover totals (or frontier cap measurements) for the two cost-18 36-row parents, cover-table ranks 6/7: even-r perfect-matching semantics with PmLazy anchored DP and algebraic perfect-matching confirmation
method: Even r = 36: every minimum cover is an exact perfect matching of 18 pair roots (18 pair roots cover at most 36 rows; any double-covered row leaves some row uncovered; 17 pairs + 1 singleton cover only 35 rows), so the total minimum-cover count is pm(full) over the weighted pair graph. Perfect matching confirmed at 18 by Tutte-matrix rank over GF(1000000007) and GF(998244353) (algebraic, independent of the combinatorial DP). pm(full) computed with PmLazy (same machinery validated against two independent implementations on the 31-row cost-16 parent) under a 8000000-state cap; if the anchored tree exceeds the cap the script records the frontier measurement (states at cap) instead of a total.
